data: {"generalSituation":"A broad trough of low pressure will continue to linger over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. Showers will be heavy at times with squally thunderstorms over the region. Meanwhile, an area of low pressure over the sea east of the Philippines may further develop and move towards Luzon. With the broad trough of low pressure weakening slightly midweek next week, there will be sunny intervals apart from a few showers over the coast of Guangdong. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Dolphin over the western North Pacific will move in the general direction of the seas south of Japan in the next few days. However, there is uncertainty in its subsequent movement. It will have a higher chance of moving towards the vicinity of the East China Sea.
